name: Cynefin Hexi Facilitation Kits
description: Physical and virtual facilitation kits developed by The Cynefin Company for facilitating Cynefin-based sensemaking workshops. Used for organizational decision-making, strategy, and innovation facilitation across all Cynefin domains.
general_score_metric: Participant-reported outcomes and qualitative measures (e.g., Likert-scale satisfaction, facilitator assessments of sensemaking/workshop effectiveness)
notes: Available as both physical and virtual kits. Designed for certified Cynefin practitioners and facilitators.
